mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I plan my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's advisable to start planning your remodeling project several months in advance, especially for larger undertakings. This allows ample time for design development, material selection, obtaining necessary permits, and scheduling with a contractor. For kitchen or bathroom remodels, planning 3-6 months ahead is common. Whole-home remodels or additions might require 6-12 months or more of planning. Early planning helps secure preferred materials, allows for custom orders, and ensures a smoother, more organized project execution without unnecessary delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan your remodeling project several months in advance; 3-6 months for kitchens/bathrooms, and 6-12 months for larger projects, to allow for design, permits, and scheduling.
